classifications.rationale: Teaches step-by-step Excel implementation (model inputs, use NORM.INV with RAND, Data Table for trials). Coverage criteria: 'set up an Excel sheet...modelling inputs, using NORM.INV...automating trials'.

Focuses on when to use Monte Carlo for complex equations, interpreting output distribution, replacing static math. Coverage criteria: 'explain how to incorporate multiple inputs...and interpret output distribution' emphasizes judgment and scenario application.
